exercises.title: Reuse scenarios 1 — common, optional or variant?
exercises.problemHtml:
In a software product line, classify features as common (in all members), optional (in some members) or variant (different versions in different members). A tax-filing product line has Free, Basic, Deluxe and Business editions.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Trong dòng sản phẩm: tính năng chung, tuỳ chọn, biến thể.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: Reuse scenarios 2 — reengineered and replacement systems
exercises.problemHtml:
Replacement systems always reuse some requirements of the original, even if they were never written. When reverse-engineering requirements from an old system, raise your thinking to a higher level of abstraction to escape implementation details; harvest the business rules embedded in the old code.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

exercises.title: Reuse scenarios 3 — sections of a requirement pattern
exercises.problemHtml:
A requirement pattern (Withall 2007) makes requirements of one type reusable. Its sections: Guidance (basics, when it applies, how to write it), Content (what such a requirement must convey, item by item), Template (fill-in-the-blanks with placeholders), Examples, Extra requirements (additional or more detailed requirements), and Considerations for development and testing. Classify each fragment of a "report requirement" pattern.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Các phần của một requirement pattern. Phân loại từng đoạn của pattern "yêu cầu báo cáo".

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

o.s: "The system shall produce a «report name» showing «content» for «audience», «frequency»."

"State: the report’s name, its purpose, its audience, its data, its sort order, its frequency."

exercises.title: Reuse scenarios 4 — apply a pattern template
exercises.problemHtml:
Pattern template: "The system shall produce a «name» report showing «content» for «audience», «frequency»." Write function fill(template, values) that replaces every «key» with values[key], and returns null if any placeholder has no value (or an empty value). Then write REPORT: the template filled for a monthly no-show report for the clinic manager.

Requirements

  • Placeholders use the characters « and ».
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Viết fill(template, values) thay mọi «key» bằng values[key], trả null nếu thiếu giá trị; rồi viết REPORT cho báo cáo no-show hằng tháng gửi quản lý phòng khám.

Yêu cầu

  • Chỗ trống dùng ký tự « và ».
hintsJson: replace với /«([^»]+)»/g và hàm thay thế.
